App: Own the current job, token, editable design and four-step workflow; subscribe to UI locale changes.
perform: Run an async action with busy/error feedback and recognize an unavailable job.
upload: Submit selected File objects as multipart data and enter design or subtitle review.
change: Update one draft Design field and mark it unsaved without contacting the backend.
save: Persist the complete Design and refresh the job snapshot only after success.
importDesign: Read a bounded design JSON, validate it through the backend and retain the previous design on failure.
action: POST one authenticated operation and replace the local job snapshot.
saveRetainedDesign: Download the in-memory design without needing an available backend job.
DesignActions: Group save feedback and explicit continuation; pending changes prevent approval.
DesignEntry: Offer manual setup or JSON import without automatically approving the background.
SubtitleReview: Load, edit and explicitly approve SRT while preserving honest word-timing availability.
run: Wrap subtitle operations with busy/error feedback.
ThemeSelector: Apply and persist the interface theme without touching episode design.
readTheme: Read an explicit browser preference, otherwise use Studio, including blocked storage.
TypographyControls: Edit independent title/subtitle fonts, title offsets and bounded logo placement.
logoStyle: Map the six logo placements to percentage-based composition CSS.
LanguageSelector: Switch the UI locale while leaving spoken audio language and episode text unchanged.
getText: Compute shared UI labels at render time so language changes remain reactive.
ApiError: Carry an HTTP status with a safe explanatory error message.
api: Fetch a same-origin API resource with header-token authentication and structured errors.
isActive: Recognize the server states that prevent conflicting edits.
artifactUrl: Build a navigable artifact URL without exposing the job token in the query string.
readLocale: Read the stored supported locale or fall back to English.
getLocale: Expose the current in-memory locale snapshot for React subscriptions.
setLocale: Persist the locale, update document language/title and notify subscribers.
useLocale: Subscribe React to the locale store without placing preferences in episode state.
t: Translate only known interface messages; never pass user-authored episode content here.
ProjectLibrary: List durable local projects and reopen or duplicate them after flushing the current design draft.
DraftAutosave: Debounce appearance recovery drafts and reject stale base versions without approving render settings.
BrandTemplates: Name, save and apply reusable visual branding while retaining episode audio/captions/title.
Preflight: Display server-measured text/layout blockers and review warnings before preview/export.
CanvasEditor: Map pointer/keyboard edits into output pixels; move/resize title and logo without auto-approval.
frameSize: Resolve landscape, portrait or square frame dimensions with backward-compatible defaults.
canvasDelta: Scale pointer deltas from displayed CSS pixels to actual output-frame pixels.
logoBox: Calculate actual logo bounds and clamp free coordinates consistently with FFmpeg.
SubtitleTimeline: Seek audio by cue and edit caption text/timestamps, keeping the raw SRT synchronized.
parseTimeline: Parse draft SRT intervals for editing; final validation remains on the server.
timelineSrt: Serialize cue edits back into millisecond-precision SRT.
begin: Capture a pointer and the original output coordinates before starting a drag/resize.
move: Apply the current pointer delta within validated title/logo bounds.
end: Release transient drag state and hide alignment guides.
keyboard: Move title/logo with arrow keys, using Shift for a larger output-pixel step.
open: Flush the current draft and request an authenticated saved-project reopen or duplication.
refresh: Reload local brand-template summaries through the library session.
update: Replace one editable cue field and serialize the new SRT draft.
resumeStep: Reopen at the latest subtitle/design/preview/export stage with valid artifacts and approvals.
